policy_name_ja: 積立利率変動型個人年金保険（21）（通貨指定型）
notes: Own rate page index_hendo_choice_21_03 (?product=202&agency=18), a separate history from 2023-02-01 (on the 92 shared dates the crediting rates differ from the _02 history only for JPY, 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-16; the MVA histories are identical). Sold through みずほ銀行 / みずほ信託銀行 per the product page. USD and JPY only.

Product type indexed_annuity (changed from fixed_annuity on 2026-11-17). The saved brochure (brochure_PremierRoadM_hanyo, sources/dfl/docs/) shows the (21) form is index-linked: at the end of the 積立利率保証期間 the 年金原資額 is the 基本移行原資額 (fixed by the contract-date 積立利率, never below 100% of the premium) plus an 指数連動移行原資額 = premium x rise of the 参照指数 since the 基準日 x 連動率 (zero if the index has not risen). The rate page publishes only the 積立利率 by currency and 5/10-year guarantee period, which is what the CSVs hold; the 連動率 and index values are not collected.
The distributors list is the 銀行・信用金庫・信用組合・証券 section of the product page.

Launch date: 2023-02-01, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2023-01-30 (id=1021, 『プレミアロードⅯ』, 積立利率変動型個人年金保険(21)(通貨指定型)). The formal name (21) is shared with other marketed names sold earlier (『安心道しるべ』 from 2021-09-01 at Resona, release id=991; 『指数連動年金』 from 2022-02-01); the date here is for this marketed name. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 February 2023 and covers USD and JPY with 5 and 10-year guarantee periods.
It has its own rate page, but its JPY rates differed from the sister Premier Journey form between April 2023 and March 2025.

Classed as an indexed annuity: per the brochure, at the end of the guarantee period a fixed amount of at least the premium is topped up by the rise in a reference index. The published rate is the fixed crediting rate; the index participation is not collected.
Launched 1 February 2023 (insurer news release); the formal name is shared with earlier marketed names.
